conversations.answer: [CODE_BLOCK_0]This script accomplishes the task by first moving the git directory to the src directory. It then updates the file paths in resetGit.js to reflect the move. Afterward, it creates a new handler for the reset Git functionality in a new file resetGitHandler.js, which will be in the src/backend/handlers directory. Finally, it updates setupRoutes.js to include the new route '/reset', which calls the newly created resetGitHandler.
